gitCommit.subject: ci: add monocart reporting and github pages deploy
gitCommit.body:
ci: add monocart reporting and github pages deploy

Configure Playwright to generate Monocart reports alongside existing outputs and publish the report to GitHub Pages on every CI run for easy access to latest test results.

Made-with: Cursor
